label: Compliant (C)
definition: Articles 3 to 8 compliant; Article 18 requirements fulfilled or not applicable.

label: Non-compliant (NC)
definition: Articles 3 to 8 non-compliant; Article 18 requirements fulfilled or not applicable.

label: Pending deadline (PD)
definition: Pending deadline: time remains for submission of the application.

label: Compliant, Article 18 not met (C+A18)
definition: Articles 3 to 8 compliant; more stringent Article 18 requirements not met.

label: Non-compliant, Article 18 not met (NC+A18)
definition: Articles 3 to 8 non-compliant; more stringent Article 18 requirements not met.
